text: A yi'ay an Nulaaɗo, tooñirɓe ko'e-mun ɓen sirku e geddi, hiɓe huliri leptireede ko ɓe faggitii kon e bakkaatu, hara le ɗum yantay e maɓɓe, feere mun alaa, nafa woo alaa e ko ɓe hulirta ɗum. Ɓen non gomɗimɓe Allah e Nulaaɗo Makko on, ɓe golli golle moƴƴe, ɓen no seedi e ɓeya; ɓee ɗoo hino e nder naakooji Aljanna, hiɓe neeminora ton, kala ko ɓe faalaa ka Joomi maɓɓe; neemaaji ɗi taƴondirtaa haa pooma. Ko ɗum tigiri, woni ɓural mawnungal, ngal alaa nanndo.
